value.title: Big Big Boots
value.synopsis: Boots makes himself gigantic to get on a new ride and wants to return to normal.

value.title: Backpack's Sticky Situation
value.synopsis: When Backpack gets stuck, Dora has to trek Tallest Mountain to get to Abuela so she can fix Mochila.

value.title: A Piñata For Mami
value.synopsis: On Piñata Day, the family-made piñata floats away, and it's up to Dora to retrieve it.

value.title: Invisi-Swiper
value.synopsis: Swiper swipes an invisibility blanket, and Dora has to retrieve it.

value.title: Isa's Royal Garden Party
value.synopsis: Isa has to prepare her garden for a visit from the Queen.

value.title: Sammy's Surprise
value.synopsis: Dora and Boots help Sammy the Sloth get to camp.

value.title: The Floor is Guava
value.synopsis: A guava geyser erupts, and it's up to Dora and Boots to stop it.

value.title: We Are The Grumples
value.synopsis: The Troll runs away from a group picture, and Dora and Boots travel under the bridge to find out why.

value.title: Crabby Wedding
value.synopsis: Swiper swipes a pearl wedding ring, and Dora treks to the ocean to find it.

value.title: The Cloud Kingdom
value.synopsis: Dora helps a vicuña find her magic flute that can take her home.

value.title: Partly Claudia
value.synopsis: Dora and Boots travel with a baby cloud so she can rain on a dry waterslide.

value.title: Ranita's Magic Stripes
value.synopsis: Dora and Boots help a frog earn her stripes to get magical healing powers.

value.title: Troll Jelly
value.synopsis: The Grumples enlist Dora's help gathering the strange ingredients required to make Troll Jelly for the Grumpy Old Troll.

value.title: Catch That Kitty!
value.synopsis: Dora and Boots must solve clues to keep track of Lucky after he darts into the rainforest.
